limits: Original procedural demonstration. Blocks support plates; rack pins support shaft; isometric variation holds a raised load below the knees. Hold duration illustrative. No physical-device, production or exhaustive mesh collision certification.

block-pull.criteria: Start with plates on equal blocks below knee; extend hips and knees with long arms then return to blocks.

pin-deadlift.criteria: Start with shaft on equal rack pins below knee; long arms, neutral back and controlled return.

isometric-deadlift-hold.criteria: Yielding isometric variation: lift from floor to below knee, hold body and bar for four seconds, then lower; no further extension.
